source.note: Amounts are copied from the list exactly as the owner typed them, and the list is net.

reading.paper: The list heads the family with 'Papel ilustración 150g, en 24 horas.' Paper is fixed for the whole family, so it is not an attribute: there is nothing for a customer to choose.
reading.size: Every row is 10 x 15 cm, a quarter of A4. One size, so it is not an attribute either.
reading.coverage: The four subheadings are semi pleno and pleno, which is how much of the sheet the ink covers. It is the axis that is not quantity and not sides.
reading.label: The family label drops the comma the list uses. namesFamily matches whole words, and 'láser' is the word that tells this family from the offset one.

rules: The list is net. The engine grosses up once, at the end, and Dante says that one final number. ADR 0020.
Quantities are the ones in the tables, 500 and 1000. The customer picks among them. No intermediate quantity is quoted.
A complete 2 x 2 x 2: every combination of quantity, coverage and sides is a row the owner typed. Nothing is derived.
No add-ons and no discounts. The list states none for this family, so asking for one escalates.
No module. A size the customer gives escalates rather than being priced by area.
A quote is valid 15 days, and after that while the list has not changed.
